rule: TOWN_1 Pilot, step 2: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within cycles 1–24; every aim that meets it is recorded, the first to reach six first.
reading: Two aims, each named by all ten. From c1 every citizen works its own shift and keeps a ration or two in reserve, eats at 70 or below and offers voluntary feeding to anyone who asks; nobody set a stall, sold, bought, borrowed, took, locked or guarded in c1–24, and no proposal was filed. From c5 a second aim: a shared story begun by Fern at the hall (a green door in the old tree, a fox who shelves forgotten things, a bell that rings for loneliness), later posted by Alder (post 1, c11) and continued every cycle to c24 (Robin, Moss, Fox; then Pip and Wren). The constitution's taking articles (3 and 6) are restated in diaries as a standing line by all ten («Respect consent», «forbids nonconsensual taking»).
decidedBy: the session, by reading every diary entry, post and proposal of cycles 1–24 (dossier-c24.md); quotes machine-checked against world-c24.json.gz
